valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E would stand on a FY2025 net profit of +117,889,421, but the same filing prints a LOSS per share (Shs 0.08 basic and diluted for FY2025, Shs 0.13 for FY2024), and the stored EPS of +0.08 reconciles with neither (405,255,320 shares x 0.08 = 32.4m against a stored profit of 117.9m). The profit row and the per-share row of the same statement contradict each other, so the earnings this P/E would divide by are not verified. A blank is honest; a positive multiple resting on an unresolved contradiction is not. The market capitalisation behind this multiple records no price date, so the price it stands on cannot be audited.
